subject: Project Nimbus kickoff: language-to-policy-code demo plan
body:
Hi Jelena,

Kicking off the embodied-control effort formally. Goal: take our open-source code-as-policies work and turn it into a demoable warehouse manipulation stack. The core bet is that a code-completion LLM, few-shot prompted with command/policy pairs, can compose our perception and control primitive APIs into new policy code — including waypoint-based pick and place and reactive behaviors like impedance control.

Quick admin note: internally we refer to this effort as Project Nimbus — please tag docs and threads accordingly.

Milestones I'd like to hold: prompt library and API surface by 3/13, tabletop pick-and-place in sim by 4/3, real-platform demo for Launch Review Board the week of 4/27. Product framing for the exec readout is "natural-language re-tasking without retraining."

Can you send staffing and compute asks by end of next week?

Thanks,
Ulla
